s: Din netilat lulab ubirkato ubo y"z seipim: mitzvat arbaa minim hallalu hu, sheyyittol kol echad veechad miyyisrael etrog echad beyado achat, ubeyado hashshenit yittol lulab echad ushene badde araba ushelosha badde hadas. Ubishat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo shelosha badde hadas — yotze yede chobato bebad echad, apillu niqtam rosho (ayyen siman trm"v). Veim natal shelosha minim ellu im haetrog beyado haachat — lo yatza yede chobato, shehare achare shenneemar "peri etz hadar" neemar "kappot temarim" belo va"v, kelomar shello neemar "vekappot" kemo shenneemar "vaanap vego' vearbe vego'", mikkan atta lamed shehaetrog hu tzarik lihyot bipne atzmo, velo yihyeh baagudda achat im hallulab im minayv kemo hahadas vaaraba shenniktab bahen va"v hammosip al inyan rishon, ulekak muttar leogdan im hallulab (veadderabba mitzva min hammubchar hu leogdan kemo sheyyitbaer). Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim, shello miet hakkatub ella shello yehe haetrog neegad im hallulab uminayv baagudda achat mammash, abal kol sheeno ogedo mammash baagudda achat ap al pi shennotelan beyado achat — en bekak kelum, veyotze yede chobato min hattora. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir beshel tora, veim berak venatal shenehem beyado achat — yachazor veyittelem bishte yadayv belo beraka, dispeq berakot lehaqel, veshemma yatza babberaka harishona:
Umitzva min hammubchar leegod hallulab im hahadas vaaraba baagudda achat mishshum noy, shenneemar "zeh eli veanvehu" — hitnaeh lepanayv bemitzvot:

Umuttar leogdo apillu bechut ubimshicha, ap al pi shechut haoged hu min acher veeno mimminim shebballulab vahare yesh kan beyado chamishsha minim — ap al pi ken eno ober mishshum "bal tosip", kevan shehaegod eno meiqqar hammitzva ella hu hiddur lammitzva, velo hizhira tora ella shello lehosip beiqqar hammitzva:

Umuttar leechoz et hallulab beyado bimqom haegod beshaa sheochazo latzet bo yede chobato, veap al pi shehaegod chotzetz ben yado lallulab uminayv — en bekak kelum, kevan shehaegod hu lenoy ulehiddur mitzva, vekol shehu lenoy — eno chotzetz, mippene shehu batel legabbe hallulab uminayv, ukeillu hu miggup hallulab uminayv:

Vaapillu im nasheru meale hallulab o meale hahadas vaaraba venisharu healin betok haegod, beinyan shealin hallalu chotzetzin umapsiqin ben yado lallulab — en bekak kelum, kevan sheddabar hachotzetz hu mimminim shebballulab, umin bemino — eno chotzetz. Abal im dabar sheeno mimminim hallalu mapsiq benehem leyado bishat netila — lo yatza yede chobato bintila zo, lekak tzarik lizzaher meod lehasir hachut sheragil lihyot karuk sebib hahadas keshemmebiin otan mimmerchaqqim. Abal muttar likrok hahadas baale hallulab o baatze araba daqqim, kevan shehakkerek hu mimminim shebballulab — eno chotzetz:

Yesh nohagim laasot haeged bederek zeh, shekkorekin sebibot shelosha minim ellu ad sheyyihyu mehuddaqin heteb, vetochabin rashe hakkerek letok iggul hakkaruk sebib shelosha minim ellu. Veyesh machamirim veqosherim shene rashe hakkerek bishne qesharim zeh al gabbe zeh, ubeyom tob shei epshar leqoshran beinyan zeh, shehare hu qesher shel qeyama sheeno choshesh lehattiro olamit — ogedin oto baaniba, dehaynu sheosin shette anibot zo al gabbe zo (abal asur laasot aniba al gabbe qesher, kevan sheeno choshesh lehattiro olamit ayyen siman (shm"a) [shy"z]), o shettochabin rashe hakkerek letok iggul hakkerek kemo shennitbaer:
Yesh nohagin lehagbiah hahadas betok haegod lemala min haaraba meat, mittaam hayyadua lahem:
Yesh nohagin leegod hahadas mimino shel hallulab vehaaraba bismolo vehallulab baemtza:
Veyesh nohagin leegod shelosha hadassim, echad mimin hallulab dehaynu mimin haadam veechad missemolo veechad baemtza noteh letzad yamin, ushette haarabot echad bimino veechad bismolo:

Vetob lehashpil hahadas vaaraba tok eged hallulab, dehaynu sheyyeegod otam betachtit hallulab, beinyan shekkesheyyittol hallulab beyado leshem mitzva yihyu beyadayv gam ken hahadas vaaraba (veim lo hishpil venatal hallulab lebaddo beyado vehahadas vaaraba agudin bo lemala — hare zeh muttar, ap al pi sheeno notel hahadas vehaaraba beyado — en bekak kelum, dilqicha al yede dabar acher — shemah leqicha kemo sheyyitbaer):

Nohagin laasot ballulab shalosh aguddot keneged shelosha abot, dehaynu shemmillebad haeged sheoged shelosha minim ellu beyachad osin ballulab atzmo od shette aguddot leegod healin bashshidra. Vetzarik lizzaher meod sheyyehe shidro shel lulab yotze lemala meeged haelyon tepach kede ninua, kemo shennitbaer besiman tr"n:

Kol arbaa minim hallalu tzarik littelan derek gedilatan, dehaynu sheyyehe rashehem lemala veiqqerehem lematta. Veim hapakan beshaa shennetalan — lo yatza yede chobato bintila zo. Vehaetrog ap al pi shehu taluy bailan uqtzo lemala, mikkol maqom derek gedilato niqra uqtzo lematta, vetzarik lizzaher meod bahadas shebba mimmerchaqqim lehattir aguddato velirot im munnach ketiqquno, delipamim notenim rosho shel bad zeh betzad iqqaro shel bad zeh, vegam lipamim kopepin rashe habbaddin:

Tzarik littol hallulab uminayv beyado haymanit veetrog beyado hassemalit, lepi shehallulab yesh bo shalosh mitzvot, dehaynu lulab hadas vaaraba, vehaetrog hu mitzva achat. Veim hapak — yatza yede chobato, umikkol maqom tob lachazor velittol kedino belo beraka. Apillu im kebar yatza yede chobat netila verotzeh lachazor velittelo leshem mitzva, kegon bishat amirat "hoshanot" — tzarik littol hallulab beyamin vehaetrog bismol:
Itter yad — notel hallulab bimino shehu semol shel kol adam vehaetrog bismolo shehu yamin shel kol adam. Abal mi shehu sholet bishte yadayv — notel hallulab bimino vehaetrog bismolo kekol adam:

Mi shenniqtea yado haymanit — yittol hallulab bizroo haymanit, shehare lo neemar battora "uleqachtem bayyad", uleqicha bazzeroa — shemah leqicha. Veim i epshar littol hallulab bizroo haymanit — yittol hallulab beyado hassemalit shehi chashuba lo keyamin veetrog bizroo hassemalit, abal lo yittol shenehem beyado achat bebat achat kemo shennitbaer. Veim i epshar lo littol haetrog bizroo hassemalit — yittol hallulab vehaetrog beyado hassemalit bazeh achar zeh kemo sheyyitbaer:
Veken mi shenniqtea yado hassemalit — yittol haetrog bizroo hassemalit. Veim i epshar — yittol bizroo haymanit. Veim gam zeh i epshar — yittol shenehem beyado haymanit bazeh achar zeh:

Kol hammitzvot mebarekin alehem ober laasiyyatan, dehaynu samuk veqodem litchillat asiyyatan, kemo shennitbaer besiman k"h. Umah hu mebarek al mitzvat netilat arbaa minim ellu? "Asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al netilat lulab", lepi shehallulab gaboah mikkullan — chashub hu, veniqret kol haagudda al shemo: tam venishlam shebach lael bore olam
